prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE opaque landscape PNG, exactly 16:9 (prefer 2048 x 1152), a master concept for a layered animated game title screen. Use the seven attached reference images: title_key_art_v05_styleD.png ONLY for rendering style, palette and environment look (cel shading, clean outlines, bright sky, rounded trees, pale rocks); DO NOT copy its composition, poses or village. sheet_1_warrior_m.png through sheet_6_archer_f.png are canonical character design references; preserve each hero's exact costume, colors, hair, equipment and especially BACK view.

SCENE AND COMPOSITION: An epic vista in the spirit of the famous Zelda: Breath of the Wild key art, with exactly six chibi heroes standing on two high grassy pale-rock promontories, seen FROM BEHIND looking toward a distant dangerous rift across a vast beautiful valley. Clean composition with symmetrical visual weight. Frame all six heroes fully without cropping, three on each side, clearly separated silhouettes and equipment. Left group and its cliff strictly within x=0%-30%; right group and cliff strictly within x=70%-100%. Preserve a generous gap between the two cliffs. All heroes/hat tips/weapons below y=32%. The top y=0%-28% is calm sky with soft clouds ONLY, no storm vortex or stone or weapon intrudes. Bottom button zone x=30%-70%, y=70%-100% contains ONLY distant shadowed green valley: no foreground rocks, no heroes, no bright detail, no bright river. Painted to every edge without border.

LEFT GROUP ordered outer edge toward centre: male archer on a slightly raised rock at x~8%, green leaf-emblem hood and green gold-trimmed tunic, brown quiver, dark trousers and brown boots, bow in one hand and the other shading his eyes; female mage at x~18%, white pointed star hat with hanging gold star, long white hair, white blue and gold star-pattern robe, spellbook held under her arm; male warrior nearest centre at x~26%, spiky brown hair, steel armor, royal-blue scarf and cape, round blue gold-rimmed four-point-star shield strapped on his back, short broad sword resting on shoulder.
RIGHT GROUP ordered centre toward outer edge: female warrior at x~74%, orange spiky high ponytail, brown leather fur-trimmed outfit and fur-trimmed brown boots, axe resting on shoulder, round wooden metal-rimmed shield on back; male mage at x~82%, blond hair, blue pointed hat with gold band and blue jewel, blue gold-trimmed star robe, dark trousers, blue boots, orb staff planted beside him; female archer at x~92%, green gold-trimmed leaf hood, long black hair, green outfit and dark thigh-high stockings and brown boots, bow in one hand and the other pointing toward the rift, on a slightly higher outer rock. Every hero faces the central distance; show backs and at most a sliver of profile, never front-facing faces. Hair, scarf, cape and robe ends blow inward toward centre. Correct hands and weapon silhouettes, all six crisp and sharply focused.

CENTRAL FOCAL POINT: exactly x=50%, y=47% is the luminous centre of a tall fissure between two colossal jagged pale stone monoliths leaning apart at the distant horizon. The fissure blazes magenta violet with white-hot core and crimson edges. Floating broken rock shards around it; a dark violet cloud vortex above it lit from below, entirely BELOW y=28%, concentrated around y=31%-39%. Ominous and unsettling but teen-friendly; no gore, skulls, monsters or eyes in crack. The rift is distant but reads instantly.
Deep green valley far below between promontories, rounded forest canopies and softly colored atmospheric mist WITHOUT optical blur, winding river leads the eye toward the rift in middle distance, distant mountain ranges both sides, a few floating rock islands near the rift. Let the river disappear into dark forest before the bottom-centre button zone.
LIGHT: warm late afternoon sunshine from upper left, violet rim lighting on heroes from rift ahead.
STYLE: Shonen-manga chibi, approximately 3.5 to 4 heads tall, bright casual medieval-fantasy 3D action game ages 12+. In the spirit of Akira Toriyama's Dragon Quest designs and Cookie Run: Kingdom. Polished in-engine 3D cel-shaded look: flat colors plus one hard shadow tone, bold clean outlines with subtle line-weight variation, simple matte materials, big readable shapes, no glossy reflections, no fine surface noise. Bright harmonious sky blue, grass green, warm yellow, coral and cream, with the rift's violet the sole ominous accent. Not generic soft Pixar. Absolutely NO depth of field blur anywhere; sharp near and distant forms, no motion blur or smeared painterly textures.
NO text, letters, logo, UI, frame, watermark or signature. Opaque full-bleed PNG.

CORRECTION FOR FINAL ATTEMPT — strict layout overrides: Previous attempt placed storm clouds at y=16% and rift centre y=36%, both MUCH TOO HIGH; cliffs extended to x=38% and x=63% and violated the button zone. Correct all of these. Treat the picture as a precisely planned 16:9 canvas. Leave y=0%-28% entirely empty of all mountains, islands, ominous clouds and objects: just calm blue sky and soft white clouds. The compact purple storm vortex occupies y=30%-36% only. The two monoliths extend from y=37% to y=59%, with glowing white fissure centre at x=50%, y=47%. They must be lowered substantially. Reduce the foreground group footprint: left cliff including all rocks ends at x=29% everywhere, right cliff begins at x=71% everywhere. Hero centre x coordinates exactly 5%, 15%, 25%, 75%, 85%, 95%, all extremities inside the side zones. Bottom central 40% is exclusively dark quiet DISTANT forest canopy, NO rock walls and NO bright waterfall or river. No buildings, village or bridges. Wind points inward on both sides, left capes/hair stream RIGHT, right capes/hair stream LEFT. Match the canonical sheets closely: female mage white hat has large blue four-point stars and hanging gold star; male mage hat has a PLAIN gold band with a blue diamond on front, no dangling ornament; male mage robe back shows ONE simple gold four-point star, not ornate sun. Warrior shield has a FOUR-point gold star, not eight points. Bold clean outlines, simple matte cel shading, eliminate intricate texture. Exactly six full-body characters in back view. Do not sacrifice empty UI zones for epic oversized scenery.

validation.method: Visual inspection of generated image opened with view_image; pixel and byte checks with Pillow and SHA-256.

exact_canonical_designs.notes: Recognizable identities, but male warrior has brown boots rather than canonical steel greaves; female mage robe decorations and other costume details differ.

bottom_center_zone_clear.notes: Cliff edges intrude around x=30%-32% and x=68%-70%; a small lighter river patch remains near the upper button-zone boundary.

no_depth_of_field_blur.notes: Heroes are sharp; distant landscape uses atmospheric softness. No obvious lens-style depth-of-field blur.

groups_within_outer_33_percent.notes: Male warrior cape extends inward to approximately x=36%.

inward_wind_both_sides.notes: Right group hair and cloth mostly blow outward to the right.

exact_16_9.notes: Native output is 1672x941, close to but not exactly 16:9; preserved byte-for-byte without crop or resampling.

alpha_stats.note: RGB source is fully opaque; alpha statistics use an implicit alpha of 255.
